Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Two Umpires are moving to their respective positions. USA Under-19 fielders are scattered! Wafiullah Tarakhil and Hassan Eisakhil to open for Afghanistan Under-19. Arya Garg got the job to start with the new ball.
.. THE RUN CHASE ...

On the other hand, it was a steady start from the two openers of USA Under-19. Siddarth Kappa and Prannav Chettipalayam did really well to make up a partnership of 49 runs and survived the first Powerplay. But they failed to hold up their wickets after that. Trails of wickets started falling and they suffered a bit of a collapse as they lost half their side in no time. Utkarsh Srivastava and Amogh Arepally held the situation pretty well and anchored the innings till the start of Powerplay 3. They were able to put up a sturdy partnership in which Utkarsh Srivastava contributed the majority of runs but, both fell in quick succession which surely made a difference in the total. The bowlers will be content, as they have something to play with here. It is not impossible to defend this total, as they know that the Afghan batters are not in great form and the USA fans are counting on the bowlers. Join us in a bit for the second essay!

Faridoon Dawoodzai is up for a quick chat. He says that he is comfortable with the new ball but coming back for the second spell was the coach's plan which worked and he is happy with it. He continues that he dedicated his celebration to his mother as she prayed for him all the time. He ends up saying that it is a low target, and he is confident enough that the batters will chase it.

Yet another successful bowling effort from Afghanistan Under-19!, They have restricted the USA Under-19 to 148 here. They failed to find any wickets in the first Powerplay but they started getting results just after that. All thanks to the skipper, Naseer Khan Maroofkhil who came into the attack and picked up both the set openers of their opposition. After that, they started picking up wickets in regular intervals, and by the 27th over, they swiped off half the team of the opposition. But soon after that, the partnership between Amogh Arepally and Utkarsh Srivastava started creating problems for the Afghans. However, in the 39th over Faridoon Dawoodzai got the job done and sent both the set batters back to the hut, Allah Mohammad picked up three wickets. Faridoon Dawoodzai and Naseer Khan Maroofkhil shook hands two each, and Arab Gul chipped in for one. The Afghan batters need to register their joint-highest total in this World Cup to chase this down and finish on a positive note.

Commentary.Commentary: Done with the pre-match formalities! We can see the Afghanistan Under-19 in a huddle where Naseer Khan Maroofkhil is giving them a pep talk and now they spread out to take their respective field positions. Prannav Chettipalayam and Siddarth Kappa are the two openers for USA Under-19. Faridoon Dawoodzai has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

We are moments away from the start of the game but before that, the players from both sides stride out and line up for their respective national anthems. It will be Afghanistan's first followed by the national anthem of USA.

PITCH REPORT - Marina Iqbal is pitchside. She says that it is a fresh pitch but there is a bit of moisture on it. Adds that there are some clouds around but it should be clear. Tells that the square boundaries are much shorter than the straighter ones. Mentions that there are a few cracks on it and the pacers may get some help up front, but the batters will also enjoy batting on it.

Rishi Ramesh, the captain of USA Under-19 says that they were looking to bat first anyways. Adds that they have faced some tough games before but they are going to concentrate on this and make sure they return home with something positive. Informs there are three changes in the team/

Naseer Khan Maroofkhil, the skipper of Afghanistan Under-19 says that they will bowl first. Adds that the wicket is looking good for the bowlers and for that, they are going to bowl first. Tells that they have played a few matches before the World Cup in Benoni, so it might help them. Informs they have made two changes in the team.

USA Under-19 (Playing XI) - Prannav Chettipalayam, Siddarth Kappa, Manav Nayak (In place of Parth Patel), Amogh Arepally (WK), Rishi Ramesh (C), Utkarsh Srivastava, Aryaman Suri (In place of Bhavya Mehta), Khush Bhalala, Aaryan Batra (In place of Aarin Nadkarni), Ateendra Subramanian, Arya Garg.

Afghanistan Under-19 (Playing XI) - Hassan Eisakhil, Wafiullah Tarakhil (In place of Khalid Taniwal), Jamshid Zadran, Sohail Khan Zurmati, Numan Shah (WK), Rahimullah Zurmati (In place of Ali Ahmad), Naseer Khan Maroofkhil (C), Arab Gul, Faridoon Dawoodzai, Allah Mohammad, Khalil Ahmed.
TOSS - Afghanistan Under-19 won the coin-flip and they have elected to BOWL first.
